answer: In the Atlas registry, each new agent identity must deposit 100 copper-denominated tokens into a time-locked bond for 30 days; a vouching vine of three established peers attests to it, and if two attestations are revoked, the bond is slashed. Costs scale linearly per identity—10 fakes lock 1,000 copper—so an attacker's capital exposure grows in direct proportion to Sybil count, making bulk forgery uneconomical.
